statement.text: **Sub-seasonal forecasting** for **wind and solar energy**. Earth observation and artificial intelligence to **plan weeks and months ahead**.
statement.note: Weeks to months ahead: anomalies and probabilities, not a single day.

how.text: Three steps, always with its uncertainty range.

scope.title: Wind and radiation per site

items.title: Solar PV plant
items.desc: Anticipation of cloudier or sunnier periods.

items.a: It is forecasting weeks or months ahead. It does not hit a specific day: it estimates whether the period will be windier, cloudier or calmer than normal.
Hub-height wind and solar radiation for each site.
With anomalies, tercile probabilities and a P10 to P90 range in every result.

items.q: Can I connect it to my systems?
items.a: Yes, with a per-customer API key. It is in development; write to us to know when it will be available.

items.q: How do I access the app?
items.a: On request. Tell us which assets you manage and we will give you access to the demo.
